findings.title: Cite current dictionary support for the bar sense
findings.details: The current 吧:bar sense and its generated has_sense relationship cite records that do not establish present-day Chinese use. The dossier includes current dictionary evidence for 酒吧 as the Chinese word for an English bar, but the sense and relationship omit it.
findings.verification: Add X-052e4b77548f8a805191 to the current bar sense and generated has_sense relationship, then obtain fresh factual and readability reviews.
